quorumSetup: 1. In Quorum: register a push workflow, issue a credential, copy Workflow ID, Key ID, and Secret (secret shown once).
2. On the n8n process set QUORUM_WORKFLOW_ID, QUORUM_KEY_ID, QUORUM_HMAC_SECRET, QUORUM_BASE_URL. Do not put secrets in this JSON.
3. On n8n 2.x set N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false so Code/Crypto expressions can read $env (or edit CONFIG literals / use Crypto credentials).
4. Import this workflow. Uses Crypto Hash + Crypto HMAC typeVersion 1 — no NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN.
5. Optional on n8n >= 2.7: upgrade HMAC node to Crypto v2, attach Crypto credentials (Hmac Secret), set QUORUM_USE_CRYPTO_CREDENTIAL=1.
6. Activate. Confirm Quorum catalog shows Healthy with Basic evidence after the first accepted heartbeat.
meta.supportedN8nRange: 1.95.3 – current stable (Crypto typeVersion 1 export; Crypto credentials preferred on >= 2.7.0)
meta.cryptoNode: n8n-nodes-base.crypto typeVersion 1 (Secret parameter + $env). Crypto credentials require typeVersion 2 (n8n >= 2.7.0).
